authentication: Verified owner Authorization Bearer required on every operation; leave additionally requires X-Cosmos-Surface-Token. Visibility and liveness use the authenticated room's sequenced BrowserControl in ambiance-room.json.

connection.token: 64 lowercase hex characters; returned only here

POST /.semantics: Explicit approval or reapproval grants public text input, atomically rotates connection and records approval; initial visible=false, sequence=0. Persisted v1 records retain output-only permission until explicit reapproval.

DELETE /:surfaceId.semantics: Owner revokes approval and invalidates connection

POST /:surfaceId/leave.semantics: Invalidates connection, not approval; rejoin requires explicit approval

Surface.name: Browser display
Surface.connected: boolean; server-derived from credential expiry, lease and leave/revoke
Surface.available: boolean; connected && visible; does not assert render verification or lead eligibility

historicalOutputOnlyManifest.semantics: All other dimensions exactly match Surface.manifest. Readable and revocable; never silently grants text input.

limitations: Registry inventory contains no assistant content; runtime delivery uses the separate authenticated connection protocol
Visibility never asserts occupancy, privacy or earned trust
Hash chaining has no external checkpoint or device countersignature yet
